name: AI consulting
summary: We assess where AI tools fit in a business, implement them, and train staff to use them in their day-to-day work.
what_we_do: Assess current processes and identify where AI tools save time.
Set up the tools the business already has access to, such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, Google Gemini, or Claude, with the company's own documents and templates.
Automate document preparation, customer communication, and reporting.
Train staff on the company's own work, with a written guide for the team.
pricing_summary: Engagements begin with a one-day operations review at $3,000, which produces a written assessment and a quote for each recommendation. Implementation is quoted from the review. Team training is $1,000 per person.

name: Systems and automation
summary: We consolidate spreadsheets and disconnected tools into a single system, build the internal tools a business needs, and automate repetitive work.
what_we_do: Consolidate spreadsheets and disconnected tools into one system of record.
Build internal tools for scheduling, quoting, tracking, and reporting.
Automate repetitive work such as data entry, follow-up, and document generation.
Document the system and hand it over to staff.
pricing_summary: Engagements begin with a one-day operations review at $3,000, which produces a written assessment and a quote for each recommendation. Implementation is quoted from the review.

name: Website and web application development
summary: We build websites, customer portals, and web applications for businesses, from a marketing site to a booking or quoting tool customers use directly.
what_we_do: Marketing websites with clear services, pricing, and a way to book or contact the business.
Customer-facing tools such as quote requests, bookings, intake forms, and portals.
Web applications that replace manual processes for staff and customers.
Hosting setup, domain configuration, and handover with documentation.
pricing_summary: Website and application projects are quoted after a scoping call. Fixed price, no hourly billing.

name: Team AI training
summary: A one-day, hands-on workshop delivered on a team's own tools, documents, and templates. Every participant leaves with a working setup and a written guide.
what_we_do: One day, on site or remote, in the AI tool the company already uses.
Participants work on their own computers with their own documents.
Each participant produces real work during the session and documents their own process.
A written guide for the team and a 30-day follow-up session are included.
pricing_summary: $1,000 per person for up to 10 people, with a 5-person minimum. Larger teams are quoted. Travel is included. A program with three monthly follow-up sessions is $1,400 per person.
